optional_pool.description: [Side Quest] High-Protein Target: Muscle is built in the kitchen. Hit your daily macro baseline without compromise.
[Side Quest] 4 Liters Hydration: Flush the system, lubricate the joints, and keep physical performance peaking.
[Side Quest] 7.5+ Hours Quality Sleep: Recovery is where the actual leveling up happens. Guard your sleep schedule.
[Side Quest] Duolingo Spanish Streak: Cognitive plasticity requires daily resistance. Complete your lesson and expand your world.
[Side Quest] The Air Fryer Protocol: Marinate and prep tomorrow's chicken breast tonight. Eliminate decision fatigue and win tomorrow before it starts.
[Side Quest] Tactical Vision: Complete today's chess puzzles. Train your mind to calculate variations and see three steps ahead of the board.
[Side Quest] Deep Lore Detachment: Read one chapter of a physical book or e-reader before bed. Disconnect from screens to drop your heart rate.
[Side Quest] Morning Sunlight Alignment: Get 10-15 minutes of direct sun within an hour of waking. Anchor your circadian rhythm for better sleep tonight.
[Side Quest] Postural Reset: 10 minutes of targeted mobility work for tight shoulders and hip flexors. Protect your biomechanics.
